name: all_dead_quiet
_comment: T558: a 1v1 with no bots where both mechs die at once and neither pilot picks (both sit in the mech picker for ~13 s). No mech is alive, so the server has no snapshot to send -- with the silence check alive again (T558) the client would take that for a dead server after 6 s and leave mid-match (peer_drop, auto-added). The server sends an empty snapshot as a heartbeat instead.
